description: This Dart file defines a class 'AppPrefs' that manages application preferences related to user login state and last username used, utilizing the SharedPreferences plugin for persistent storage. It includes methods to get and set the last username, login status, and logout functionality, with safeguards for preview environments where plugin initialization may fail.

classes.name: AppPrefs
classes.description: A utility class for persisting and retrieving user login state and last username using SharedPreferences, with safeguards for preview environments

methods.name: _prefs
methods.description: Returns a Future resolving to the singleton SharedPreferences instance

methods.name: _prefsSafe
methods.description: Safely attempts to get SharedPreferences with a timeout, returning null if failed

methods.name: getLastUsername
methods.description: Retrieves the last username used, returning null if none or if preferences are unavailable

methods.name: setLastUsername
methods.description: Stores the provided username, trimming whitespace, or removes the key if the username is empty

methods.name: isLoggedIn
methods.description: Checks whether the user is considered logged in based on stored preferences

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears the logged-in state while preserving the last username
